statements.quote: Recent research has quietly confirmed that intravenous vitamin C, administered at high doses, reaches blood concentrations sufficient to kill cancer cells in combination with chemotherapy, and is being retried in multiple oncology centers as of 2025.

source.title: Mad Honey, chapter 4: the pharmaceutical machine (Nir Strulovitz)

statements.approval: Never seriously evaluated by the US FDA.
statements.note: Linus Pauling and Ewan Cameron reported better survival in terminally ill cancer patients in the 1970s. Mayo Clinic trials used oral vitamin C instead and failed.
